id: 04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained
title: 低温截止阀的安全操作
source_doc: course/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained.md
author_source: project/Industrial Gas & Cryogenic Equipment/04_EquiTips RegO SK Series Cryogenic Globe Valves Explained/src.py

points.K2: 口径和连接方式要匹配
points.S5: 储罐与阀门的法规要求

shots.scene: 欣欣站在液氮储罐旁的结霜管路前，管路上有蓝色手轮阀门，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a frosty cryogenic pipeline with blue handwheel valves beside a large liquid nitrogen storage tank, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲低温截止阀的安全操作。
overlay: 低温截止阀的安全操作

shots.scene: 手套、慢转箭头、泄压阀、打叉扳手四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: a cryogenic glove, a slow turning arrow, a pressure relief valve, and a wrench crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 戴好防护，慢慢开关，带压不修。

shots.scene: 阿杰徒手去拧一个结霜的阀门手轮
shots.prompt_en: The young male student reaches with bare hands toward a frosty blue handwheel on a cryogenic valve.
shots.narration: 阿杰看阀门拧不动，想徒手使劲扳。

shots.scene: 徒手握结霜手轮、用长管加力的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand on a frosty valve handwheel and a long cheater bar on it, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 冻住的阀门硬扳，可能伤手又伤阀。

shots.scene: 老李戴防冻手套和面屏走过来，示意阿杰停手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing cryogenic gloves and a face shield, walks over and signals the young male student to stop.
shots.narration: 老李说：先停下，低温阀门有讲究。

shots.scene: 储罐、管路、截止阀的示意图，液体从罐里经阀门流出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cryogenic storage tank connected by a pipe through a globe valve, liquid flowing out when the valve opens. No people.
shots.narration: 低温截止阀，开关液氮等低温介质。

shots.scene: 截止阀剖面示意：手轮、阀杆、填料、阀座
shots.prompt_en: A simple cutaway diagram of a globe valve showing a handwheel, a long stem, packing and a seat. No people.
shots.narration: 转手轮，阀杆带着阀芯压紧阀座。

shots.scene: 长阀杆把手轮和冷的阀体隔开的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an extended valve bonnet keeping the handwheel far from the frosty cold valve body. No people.
shots.narration: 加长阀杆，让手轮离冷的部分远一些。

shots.section_title: 口径和连接方式要匹配
shots.scene: 大小不同的阀门图标，端部有螺纹、法兰、焊接三种
shots.prompt_en: Icons of valves of different sizes with three end types: threaded, flanged and welded. No people.
shots.narration: 口径和连接方式要和管路匹配。
overlay: 口径和连接方式要匹配

shots.section_title: 口径和连接方式要匹配
shots.scene: 老李对照空白图纸核对阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer compares a valve with a blank pipeline drawing on a clipboard.
shots.narration: 选型由专业人员按图纸确认。

shots.scene: 阀杆处冷气冒出的示意，旁边雪花图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of cold vapor leaking from around a valve stem, with a snowflake icon. No people.
shots.narration: 低温下密封件会收缩，容易漏。

shots.scene: 弹簧压紧填料的示意，打绿勾
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a spring pressing on stem packing rings to keep them tight, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 弹簧压紧填料，能自动补偿收缩。

shots.scene: 锥形阀芯落进阀座的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a cone-shaped valve plug seating neatly into a valve seat. No people.
shots.narration: 合理的阀座设计，密封稳、维护少。

shots.scene: 老李在工作台上检查一个拆下的阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer inspects a removed globe valve on a workbench with a magnifying glass.
shots.narration: 阀门要定期检查和维护。

shots.scene: 一体式阀座零件和少量工具图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a one-piece valve seat part and a small set of tools. No people.
shots.narration: 结构简单，维修更快，更少出错。

shots.scene: 老李戴手套轻松转动手轮
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer, wearing cryogenic gloves, turns a handwheel smoothly with one hand.
shots.narration: 手轮好转，操作人员不用硬使劲。

shots.scene: 锤子敲阀门、长管加力的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a hammer striking a valve and a long pipe used as a lever on a handwheel, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得锤击阀门，不得用加力杆。

shots.scene: 老周和阿杰核对空白采购单
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the young male student check a blank purchase form together.
shots.narration: 低温阀门要走正规渠道采购。

shots.scene: 带合格标签的阀门打勾，无标签散件打叉
shots.prompt_en: A valve with a blank certificate tag and a green check next to loose unlabeled valve parts crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不得随意换成来路不明的阀门。

shots.scene: 老李戴防冻手套、面屏，穿长袖实验服
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer wears loose cryogenic gloves, a full face shield and a long-sleeved coat beside a cryogenic valve.
shots.narration: 开关低温阀门，戴防冻手套和面屏。

shots.scene: 徒手摸结霜管道的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bare hand touching a frosty pipe, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 结霜的管道阀门，不能徒手碰。

shots.scene: 手轮上一个缓慢转动的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A handwheel with a slow curved arrow showing gentle turning. No people.
shots.narration: 开阀要慢，防止液体冲击和喷溅。

shots.scene: 老李站在阀门侧面开阀，不正对出口
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer stands to the side of the valve outlet while slowly opening it.
shots.narration: 人站侧面，不正对出口。

shots.scene: 两只关闭的阀门之间的一段管子，里面液体变成气泡，压力表指针上升
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a pipe section between two closed valves, liquid inside boiling into bubbles and a blank gauge needle rising. No people.
shots.narration: 液体关在两阀之间，受热会急剧升压。

shots.scene: 管段上的安全泄放阀在排气
shots.prompt_en: A small safety relief valve on the pipe section venting a puff of vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 管段要有安全泄放装置。

shots.scene: 安全阀被堵住的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a safety relief valve plugged and tied shut, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 安全阀不能堵，不能随意关断。

shots.scene: 老李关闭上下游两只阀门
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer closes the upstream and downstream valves on a cryogenic line.
shots.narration: 维修前，先关上下游阀门。

shots.scene: 压力表指针回零，管道霜层化开
shots.prompt_en: A blank gauge needle returning to zero and frost melting off the pipe. No people.
shots.narration: 安全泄压、回温，确认无压。

shots.scene: 扳手拧带压结霜阀门的图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a wrench on a frosty pressurized valve with a blank gauge, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 压力管路不得带压拆卸。

shots.scene: 阀门上挂空白警示牌，锁住
shots.prompt_en: A closed valve with a padlock and a blank warning tag hanging on it. No people.
shots.narration: 挂牌上锁，防止别人误开。

shots.section_title: 储罐与阀门的法规要求
shots.scene: 王老师在空白屏幕前讲解，屏幕上是储罐和阀门图标
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator explains in front of a blank screen showing icons of a storage tank and a valve.
shots.narration: 低温储罐属于压力容器管理范围。
overlay: 储罐与阀门的法规要求

shots.section_title: 储罐与阀门的法规要求
shots.scene: 储罐区墙上的氧含量报警器和通风口
shots.prompt_en: An oxygen level alarm and a ventilation louver on the wall of a cryogenic tank area. No people.
shots.narration: 储罐区要通风，必要时装氧含量报警。

shots.section_title: 储罐与阀门的法规要求
shots.scene: 液氧阀门旁油壶图标，打红叉
shots.prompt_en: A valve icon with an oxygen symbol next to an oil can icon crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液氧阀门严禁沾油脂。

shots.scene: 管路接头处冒出大量白雾
shots.prompt_en: Thick white cold vapor billows from a leaking joint on a cryogenic pipeline. No people.
shots.narration: 管路大量冒白雾，可能是泄漏。

shots.scene: 小研带阿杰撤到走廊，向老周报告
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student leads the young male student out into the corridor and reports to the older man by phone.
shots.narration: 远离现场，报告负责人和老李。

shots.scene: 电话图标旁有火焰和红十字
shots.prompt_en: A telephone icon with a fire icon and a red cross icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 有人受伤或晕倒，拨打119、120。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现手套、面屏、慢转箭头图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a glove, a face shield and a slow turning arrow.
shots.narration: 戴好防护，慢开慢关，不硬扳。

shots.scene: 安全泄放阀、压力表回零、挂锁三个打勾图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons with green checks: a safety relief valve, a gauge at zero and a padlock with a tag. No people.
shots.narration: 能泄压，不封液，维修先泄压挂牌。

shots.scene: 出口和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an exit door and a telephone. No people.
shots.narration: 泄漏先撤离，报告并求援。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在整齐的低温管路旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, wearing cryogenic gloves, waves goodbye beside a tidy cryogenic pipeline with blue handwheel valves.
shots.narration: 低温阀门慢慢来，安全每一天，下次见！
